tests.title: Transport executes single rate-limit retry with injectable sleep and returns ErrRateLimited if limit exceeded
given: a GitHub client configured with an injected sleep function and mock server simulating 429 and 403 quota exhaustion
tests.when: an HTTP request receives 429 or 403 quota exhaustion with backoff <= 120s versus backoff > 120s
then: the custom sleep function is invoked for the backoff duration and the request is retried once when backoff <= 120 seconds
returns an error satisfying IsRateLimited(err) == true when backoff > 120 seconds or retry fails
the injected sleep function is called instead of time.Sleep during retries
tests.pseudocode:
var slept time.Duration
sleepFn := func(d time.Duration) { slept = d }

// Case 1: 429 with 5-second backoff succeeds on retry
attempts := 0
srv1 := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
    attempts++
    if attempts == 1 {
        w.Header().Set("Retry-After", "5")
        w.WriteHeader(http.StatusTooManyRequests)
        return
    }
    w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
    w.Write([]byte(`{"full_name": "o/r"}`))
}))
defer srv1.Close()
c1 := newTestGitHubClient(Options{BaseURL: srv1.URL, Token: "tok"})
c1.sleep = sleepFn
_, err1 := c1.GetRepository(context.Background(), Repo{Owner: "o", Name: "r"})
assert err1 == nil
assert attempts == 2
assert slept == 5*time.Second

// Case 2: 403 quota exhaustion with > 120s backoff aborts immediately
srv2 := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
    w.Header().Set("X-RateLimit-Remaining", "0")
    w.Header().Set("X-RateLimit-Reset", strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().Add(200*time.Second).Unix(), 10))
    w.WriteHeader(http.StatusForbidden)
}))
defer srv2.Close()
c2 := newTestGitHubClient(Options{BaseURL: srv2.URL, Token: "tok"})
c2.sleep = sleepFn
_, err2 := c2.GetRepository(context.Background(), Repo{Owner: "o", Name: "r"})
assert issuex.IsRateLimited(err2) == true

assert errors.Is(err409, issuex.ErrConflict)

given: an authenticated GitHub client with an injected zero-delay sleep function and mock server simulating 403 quota exhaustion on first attempt
tests.when: calling GetRepository on the client encountering an initial rate limit response with 2 second backoff
then: injected sleep function is invoked with 2 seconds, the request is retried once, and the repository metadata is successfully returned
tests.pseudocode:
var slept time.Duration
c, err := issuex.NewGitHub(issuex.Options{BaseURL: mockServer.URL, Token: "ghp_mocktoken"})
assert err == nil
c.(*githubClient).sleep = func(d time.Duration) { slept = d }

repo, err := c.GetRepository(ctx, issuex.Repo{Owner: "agentfox", Name: "agent-fox"})
assert err == nil
assert repo.FullName == "agentfox/agent-fox"
assert slept == 2*time.Second
